reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her direct message with me. I confirmed her new cutoff: 26 September for the Brackenwater Freight Co. paperwork on the Juniper renewal. I told her it stays between the two of us.

I also told her I have no separate memory store, so that DM is the only record I'll go back to. If the date changes, she should tell me there.

One thing I flagged: 26 September has already passed this year, since today is 14 October. I asked whether she means next year's date or a cutoff that repeats every year.

That was the only action I took. I didn't read any channels, write any files, or send any mail.
